about.label: About
about.statement: I’m Evgeny — a full-stack developer with five years of freelance work and two years of commercial product development. I help businesses turn ambitious ideas into reliable, scalable, high-performance software.
paragraphs: I’ve worked remotely with ContentBuilder.ai, a San Francisco startup building an AI-powered content creation platform, and completed 40 freelance projects on Freelancehunt with a 5.0 client rating.

My work spans SaaS platforms, admin dashboards and AI integrations, a cryptocurrency exchange built from scratch and real-time gaming platforms — from frontend architecture to backend, databases and deployment.

experience.title: ContentBuilder.ai
experience.meta: AI startup · San Francisco, USA · Remote
experience.text: Developed and maintained React and Next.js interfaces for an AI-powered content creation platform, contributed to the frontend architecture and complex interactive features, and integrated AI functionality and backend APIs with an international team.

experience.title: Freelance
experience.text: Five years of client work: commercial SaaS applications, admin dashboards, database-driven tools, CRUD systems and role-based access control — built from scratch and maintained in production.

experience.title: Blockchain & finance
experience.text: Built a cryptocurrency exchange platform from the ground up, including user accounts, balances, transaction management and backend integrations.

experience.title: Gaming & interactive
experience.text: Interactive gaming platforms with poker, chess, backgammon and checkers, along with sports-related systems and live-streaming integrations.

process.label: Process
title: How we’ll
work together
process.intro: A transparent, predictable workflow. You always know what’s happening, what’s next and why.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: We clarify goals, users and constraints. I ask the uncomfortable questions early, so there are no surprises later.

steps.title: Architect
steps.description: Data model, system boundaries and stack choices are designed up front — the decisions that are expensive to change later.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Short iterations with working software you can click through. Progress is visible every week, not just at the end.

steps.title: Refine
steps.description: Performance, accessibility, motion and edge cases. This is where a working product becomes a polished one.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: Production launch, documentation and a smooth handover. I stay available for improvements and long-term support.
